gates.description: Documentation must be deployed before or simultaneously with the feature release
All code examples must be tested and produce the expected output shown
Breaking changes must have a migration guide in the documentation
Documentation must be reviewed for technical accuracy by an engineer
Terminology must be consistent with the product glossary throughout all documents
Screenshots must match the current UI — stale screenshots confuse users more than they help

anti_patterns.description: Documentation created during initial launch, never updated — within months it is misleading
Every option documented in a single massive page — the reader cannot find what they need
Written by engineers, for engineers — acronyms unexplained, context missing, steps skipped
Documentation relies heavily on screenshots that are never updated — old UI confuses readers
Critical knowledge lives in one person's head — when unavailable, the team is stuck

escalation_triggers: Major product feature shipping without documentation
Documentation is consistently inaccurate and engineering will not prioritize fixes
Users are repeatedly failing tasks despite documentation existing
Documentation infrastructure is unreliable (build failures, search broken)
Regulatory requirement for documentation that is not being met
Localization needed for a new market but no localization process exists

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with feature specification and API definitions

output_certifications: Documentation deployed before or simultaneously with feature release
All code examples tested and produce expected output
Documentation reviewed for technical accuracy by an engineer
No stale screenshots — UI matches current product
